source: CMS Doctors and Clinicians National Downloadable File
landing_page_row_count_note: The indexed dataset detail page showed an older August 18 / September 10 snapshot and 3,388,628 rows; the current CMS metastore API reports modified 2026-10-02, released 2026-10-15, and points to the current CSV resource. The locally supplied file has 3,630,233 parsed data rows. Treat the detail-page count as stale; current resource metadata and matching filename support the local file as the current dataset download.
reason_not_joined: The CMS file has no payer TIN, commercial plan/network participation, or per-address verification date. It can suggest clinician address and Medicare specialty candidates, but cannot establish a Centene TIN-to-address or PPO relationship.
data_dictionary_scope: One row per clinician/enrollment/group/address combination; CMS describes a 12-month claims lookback.
address_screen: California rows with street, city, and a five-digit ZIP; PO Boxes excluded. Address completeness is a candidate screen, not payer verification.
